Sandwiched between Toronto's hippest neighborhoods: Bloordale, Brockton Village, Junction Triangle and Roncasevalles.

neighborhood_overview:
The Annex is mainly residential, with tree-lined one-way streets lined with Victorian and Edwardian homes and mansions, most of them built between 1880 and the early 1900s. The 1950s and 1960s saw the replacement of some homes and mansions with mid-rise and a handful of high-rise apartment buildings in the International style. These were surrounded with landscaped green spaces in an attempt to better fit into the neighbourhood. Some of architect Uno Prii's most expressive, sculptural apartment buildings are located in the Annex. The neighbourhood has a thriving cultural scene, with the Tranzac (Toronto Australia-New Zealand) Club, the Hot Docs Ted Rogers Cinema, the Jewish Community Centre, Trinity-St. Paul's United Church where many community events occur, and the now closed Poor Alex Theatre at Bloor and Brunswick. Stores are open late and some restaurants are open well past midnight.

Hi there! 

Here's a little bit about us.  
SHE's a cabin in the city kind of girl, who writes and also dabbles in doodles. 
HE's a tech guy who dreams especially big. Together, we've been busy, getting lost and found, around the world.

We are still learning about each other, about ourselves, and about the world. The more we travel,  the more it confirms how little we have seen.   And this is fuel for us.    Having explored far and wide,  Toronto is still our favourite place to be.

We are travellers.  Incessantly so.  But, we are also homebodies, so our home is very important to us. Since this is our base, we have made this exactly what we seek out when we travel.  We've taken ideas from every spot we have ever stayed to create THE ideal place for guests.  

Collectors of books, vinyl records, art, driftwood, recipes, wildflowers, words, wide brim hats, love notes, light fixtures, Polaroids, textures, people, and experiences — you can see and feel our collections throughout!

Exploring is what we do and we love to explore Toronto thoroughly.  We have an enormous collection of tips, must-dos and must-sees, from cafes, bakeries, parks,  restaurants, concert venues,  and events, to places to bike ride, wander, and get lost in this city. *Dundas West (aka DuWest) and Ossington = absolutely popping with nightlife.

My home is located across the street from the infamous Woodbine Beach, which is the largest of the four beaches in the Beaches in Toronto, Ontario. Located along Lake Shore Boulevard at the foot of Woodbine Avenue, it is next to Ashbridge's Bay and Kew-Balmy Beach.

host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. I've also been complimented on my knack for home design and couple that with being slightly OCD and my years of landlord experience, I feel I'm able to provide the settings that I have always loved and remembered in my own personal travels. I have moved into a very large home right across from Woodbine Beach where I have already had very positive hosting experiences right from the get-go! 

The location, home and decor is not only premium but I pay careful attention to detail is what I hope will resonate with my guests. My friends and family have referred to my new home as the Bougie Beach House and that has been coined as one of Toronto's best beach AirBnB's!

name: Large Room in Boujee Beach House (Woodbine Beach)
description:
We're long-standing Superhosts but after a 2-year COVID hiatus and renovations, we're back!

The Boujee Beach home is nestled in the very family/dog-friendly, Pleasantville community in Toronto's infamous Beaches.

The AirBnB bedrooms and shared bathroom are on a dedicated floor for guests, furnished with a new Queen bed, TV, Amazon Firestick (Movies, Netflix, YouTube, etc) mirrored closet, ceiling fan and a smart bedroom lock in a SHARED setting with me, my partner and our friendly dog, Mango.
neighborhood_overview:
LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!

My home is located across the street from the infamous Woodbine Beach, which is the largest of the four beaches in the Beaches in Toronto, Ontario. Located along Lake Shore Boulevard at the foot of Woodbine Avenue, it is next to Ashbridge's Bay and Kew-Balmy Beach.

Here you will find everything from an Olympic sized swimming pool (FREE to enter), boardwalk, volleyball courts, parks, BBQ’s, restaurants, Tim Horton’s and even a Booster Juice! There are a plethora of events held in and around this area which include Toronto Jazz Festival, Woofstock, Ribfest, Electric Island, Fireworks and all of the weekly events held at Woodbine Park. There are also many cool bars, pubs, restaurants and even pizza places, all within walking distance of the house!

I am accessible by TTC if you want to venture downtown for even more restaurants, clubs, pubs, shows, landmarks and events!
host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. I've also been complimented on my knack for home design and couple that with being slightly OCD and my years of landlord experience, I feel I'm able to provide the settings that I have always loved and remembered in my own personal travels. I have moved into a very large home right across from Woodbine Beach where I have already had very positive hosting experiences right from the get-go! 

The location, home and decor is not only premium but I pay careful attention to detail is what I hope will resonate with my guests. My friends and family have referred to my new home as the Bougie Beach House and that has been coined as one of Toronto's best beach AirBnB's!

neighborhood_overview:
St. Clair West Village is in mid-town Toronto: just on the edge of busy downtown but in a quiet neighbourhood with lots to offer. Great restaurants, a new brewery, decadent ice-cream shops, a great local art gallery, and on the edge of the famous Coso Italia neighbourhood.

Several things we love about the neighbourhood (in addition to the easy access to anywhere): great little restaurants and hide-away places, Wychwood Barns both as a park and for the Saturday farmer's market, the local art gallery across the street from us that also does one-day pottery workshops, Mofer Coffee for AMAZING coffee and cookies (also across the street), The Green Jar home goods store for all natural home products, Cedarvale Park and Ravine, the new and happening Brazykuts Barbershop, and Atomic 10 tacos!
host_about:
I am a fun loving and easy going girl who moved to Toronto from Vancouver a few years back to build a family with my wonderful partner Allyson.  We have two beautiful kids and when we aren't adventuring at beaches or local hiking spots, we are trying to remember what sitting silently on a sunny patio sipping a craft IPA feels like.   
We renovated this house a few years ago and are thrilled to share it with like-minded travellers who want to enjoy what Toronto has to offer, but also want to live like a local in a "real" neighbourhood.

We picked this neighbourhood because of the vibe - on the verge of becoming trendy, but solidly holding on to the old-school roots.  We are sandwiched between Corso Italia and Little Jamaica, with plenty of modern restaurants sprinkled throughout.  

We love trying local wines and beers, so if that interests you please let us know.   We also love being a tourists in our own city so if you're looking for fun things to do or the best restaurants to eat at we would be more than happy to compile a list for you.

We hope you enjoy our place as much as we do! Happy travels!

About us: Jocelyn works for a non-profit that works with at-risk young people in Scarborough. Allyson works at a university think-tank that makes homelessness research accessible and practical for social service organizations.

neighborhood_overview:
The Annex is mainly residential, with tree-lined one-way streets lined with Victorian and Edwardian homes and mansions, most of them built between 1880 and the early 1900s. The 1950s and 1960s saw the replacement of some homes and mansions with mid-rise and a handful of high-rise apartment buildings in the International style. These were surrounded with landscaped green spaces in an attempt to better fit into the neighbourhood. Some of architect Uno Prii's most expressive, sculptural apartment buildings are located in the Annex. The neighbourhood has a thriving cultural scene, with the Tranzac (Toronto Australia-New Zealand) Club, the Hot Docs Ted Rogers Cinema, the Jewish Community Centre, Trinity-St. Paul's United Church where many community events occur, and the now closed Poor Alex Theatre at Bloor and Brunswick. Stores are open late and some restaurants are open well past midnight.

neighborhood_overview: Located in the heart of Toronto, Kensington Market is Toronto's most vibrant and diverse neighbourhood. A warm community of people offering unique wares, tasty eats, festivals n' fairs , and lot's of other fine goods and services. In 2006, it was designated a National Historic Site of Canada. Robert Fulford wrote that "Kensington today is as much a legend as a district. The (partly) outdoor market has probably been photographed more often than any other site in Toronto." TripAdvisor calls it the bohemian heart of Canada, based in a multicultural history, it is now a flurry of independent stores, restaurants, bars and shops that bring the world's foods to one tightly knit community. You can find any food on the planet in Kensington Market. It is not an uncommon thing to find a festival in Kensington Market making the bohemian party atmosphere complete.
host_about:
During the day I am a passionate Scientist, holding a PhD in Computational Biology, working towards "Global Impact" in my life time [Work hard]. At night, on weekends, during travel, or just days off, I am outdoors being as active as humanly possibly [Play hard]. To the people I surround myself with, I give my entire heart to [Love hard].

Work hard. Play hard. Love hard. I live by this statement to a T.

I have lived in Vancouver for 10 years and absolutely love the proximity and accessibility of the city to the ocean and mountains. I am an explorer by nature and always seeking a new adventure. I've explored all of Vancouver's popular hikes, waterways, and mountains by foot, kayak, and ski/snowboard, respectively.

neighborhood_overview:
Welcome to the east beach of Toronto, where the boardwalk ends and the sky begins. Still just steps away from everything you need and offering the best of the city's running, swimming, kayaking and more, this end of the beach also has one of the few dark areas to see the moon and stars at night.

Walkers and runners, be sure to bring your shoes, for the boardwalk offers many kms of trails and connects to the entire waterfront trail system, as well as many areas to sit and read, picnic and swim. The beach does get busy on weekends in the summer months, but that can also be half the fun!

Winter or summer, this sweet spot is a photographer's dream, with the waves in summer for surfing or kayaking, and in winter for ice sculptures. The awesome vintage Fox Cinema is so close you can hop in for a matinee in your pjs! host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. I've also been complimented on my knack for home design and couple that with being slightly OCD and my years of landlord experience, I feel I'm able to provide the settings that I have always loved and remembered in my own personal travels. I have moved into a very large home right across from Woodbine Beach where I have already had very positive hosting experiences right from the get-go! 

The location, home and decor is not only premium but I pay careful attention to detail is what I hope will resonate with my guests. My friends and family have referred to my new home as the Bougie Beach House and that has been coined as one of Toronto's best beach AirBnB's!

name: ALL Rooms in Boujee Beach House (Woodbine Beach)
description:
With the exception of the garage, home business workroom and top-floor Master bedroom, guests will be using 2000 sqft of this 3000 sqft house!

There is a dedicated 3rd floor with a Large Room (1 Queen Bed + 1 Twin sleeper sofa) and a Cozy Room (1 Queen Bed), both rooms sharing a newly renovated bathroom dedicated for guests only. There's also a laundry room for guests to use but in addition, there's a private room with a full ensuite, 1 Queen bed and 1 Double sleeper sofa with its own entrance.
host_about:
I am a workaholic and don't often find time away from my many jobs and commitments to go on vacation but when I do, it's definitely a blessing and take full advantage of my free time. I am also often mistaken for being half my age but rest assured, I am a mature and accomplished professional and blooming philanthropist!

I have been to some incredible places, meeting the most interesting people, forging long-lasting friendships and staying in some of the most unique homes and communities.  I always pack a couple of cameras on my trips as I am an avid amateur photographer. I do, however, take the time to bask in the experience and put the camera away, eating and drinking local food and beverages, practicing my French and Spanish when I can, while also learning useful words and phrases of other countries, while also sharing my Canadian experiences and culture. I like to be active and hike mountains, trek countrysides or walk and shop in cities, seek out monuments, landmarks or famous tourist spots. I equally enjoy taking things very slow, dipping my feet in the ocean, falling asleep on a beach or sitting in a cafe for hours talking about everything and nothing at all.

After a long day, I like to retire back to the AirBnB, charge my phone and cameras and rifle through my photos and videos and plan my following day's itinerary. For this reason, I like to choose AirBnB's with the comforts of home, which as a clean bed, bathroom and living room area where I can relax and unwind. Equally important is safety, privacy and security of the AirBnB and surrounding area so I know I'm always in a good neighbourhood and feel like I'm at home while being away from my own home. A beautiful view is always nice but not necessary as I don't spend enough time in the AirBnB but cleanliness and having comforts of home make stays much more enjoyable for me.

I am extremely respectful of other people's property and belongings, especially as a long-time Landlord myself of both short/long term rentals and know how important it is to treat people's home as your own. I am friendly, trustworthy, quiet and very respectful of others and their homes, so as not to disrupt neighbours or anyone else who may be sharing the space along with me. I am also very clean and will often leave my rentals in the same clean state or cleaner than when I arrived despite already paying for a cleaning fee (I attribute that to having slight OCD.) I like leaving a rental with the hopes that I may reach out to that Host again in the future and will be invited back to rent from them again and you can't do that if you're messy, dirty or noisy!

Given my positive experiences as an AirBnB Guest, I've embarked on a new adventure as an AirBnB Host in 2019! Having already been a seasoned landlord in both commercial and residential spaces for both short and long term rentals, I find this transition into becoming an AirBnB Host a very easy pivot with many transferrable skills. I've also been complimented on my knack for home design and couple that with being slightly OCD and my years of landlord experience, I feel I'm able to provide the settings that I have always loved and remembered in my own personal travels. I have moved into a very large home right across from Woodbine Beach where I have already had very positive hosting experiences right from the get-go! 

The location, home and decor is not only premium but I pay careful attention to detail is what I hope will resonate with my guests. My friends and family have referred to my new home as the Bougie Beach House and that has been coined as one of Toronto's best beach AirBnB's!
